test_title: PYST 43: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 16 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43127d1533a8849ab3df72e41088006ead31d69702883f3be34a34332d6a8a5a.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Each letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -3, -3.

Let’s check each option:

1. OR - LO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a065210be58025ac543751b4a86258672dc33b81d5413a40400891271f4f1088.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -3, -3.

2. QT - NP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf26e85e9d26718c194f4d2eb8d695f9573cbc7ebbebf21eefb3c61816a3f581.png] 

This letter-cluster pair does not follow the pattern -3, -3.

3. MP - JM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba8c117cfc2c338bf28ffc8d3322b6e27ffcc68a2fce682119aee5d89751335e.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -3, -3.

4. IL - FI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ebe4dbfed7171cb9b384674df4889d95682136ddb4d4d376699952943ebceb2.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern -3, -3.

Thus, QT - NP is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".
